movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Life Dew
movelist.effect: The user and all allies in the burst regain Hit Points equal to 1/4 of their Maximum Hit Points.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Giga Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.effect: The target cannot gain positive Combat Stages or trade in Digestion Buffs for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Regal Challenge
abilities.effect: Ask the target if they will show deference or defiance. If they choose Deference, the target loses their next Shift action and loses 3 CS in the Stat of the user’s choice.  If they choose Defiance, the user gains a +10 Bonus to all Damage Rolls for the rest of the Scene.
